tasks.title: Swarm Phase A — Evidence-Based Strategy Research
tasks.why: Stage 1 target: 300 strategies backtested across the full multi-pair × multi-TF matrix (10 Bybit spot pairs × 5m/15m/1h/4h) over Jun 2025 → May 2026, with positive Expectancy R. SMOKE TEST RULE (locked, June 19, 2026): native pair/TF from source first; if not stated, test ETH/USDT across all 4 supported TFs; only positive ExpR + ≥40 trades count. As of 2026-06-19 evening: **8 unique verified winners (3 stale-removed from 11), 55 strict-pass cells, 2.67% Stage 1, 86 active ports**. Native Pair Prior expansion today: 12+1+0 = 13 new strict-pass cells from 126 cells tested. Tier 4 (11 ports) failed 11/11. **Key insight: DNA is pair+TF specific, not transferable.**
tasks.nextAction:
DONE TODAY: Native Pair Prior batches 1+2 (+12 strict-pass), Tier 4 unverified theses (11 ports all failed), Dormant ports native pair (1 new verified winner #8 HarmonicDivergence), 3 more official freqtrade ports (all failed, archived), stale verification (3 unmined 'verified' confirmed unverified), TF exploration (0 strict, DNA pinned to native TF).

PATH FORWARD:
- (1) Run more Native Pair Prior batches on the 8 verified winners — proven 19% hit rate, ~4-5 new strict-pass per 28-cell batch
- (2) MQL5→Freqtrade pipeline (4-8h build) for true new DNA — DEFERRED
- (3) Investigate time/seasonality DNA — narrow hour windows (HourBased default 20h is too wide)
- (4) Walk-forward validation — quality scoring on existing 8 — DEFERRED

TARGET: 8 → 15 verified winners by end of week (~2-3 more batches)
tasks.notes:
Stage 1 = 300 backtested + ranked strategies across the full 10-pair × 4-TF matrix. SMOKE TEST PRIORITY (locked, no exceptions):
  1. If strategy source states native pair → test that pair
  2. If strategy source states native TF → test that TF
  3. If native pair/TF not stated → fallback to ETH/USDT across ALL 4 supported TFs (5m/15m/1h/4h)
  4. PASS = positive ExpR AND ≥40 trades → enters candidate pool
  5. FAIL = no entry, but re-test if source of edge changes

RANKING (locked): continuous, globally AND by 5 Fear/Greed market states (Extreme Fear / Fear / Neutral / Greed / Strong Greed from alt.me daily). Market state = passive tag only — NEVER affects strategy behavior or entries.

NO FINE-TUNING (Six's rule): TheForceV2-V6 are archived and do NOT count as separate strategies.
No GitHub pushes without Six's explicit review.

subtasks.title: ✅ Tier 4 unverified thesis batch (2026-06-19): 8 ports, 0/8 verified, all archived
subtasks.description:
Ported 7 unverified theses (009 NFI X6, 011 Twelve Strategies M7, 012 Stat Arb, 014 MR no-ML, 015 MoniGoMani MTF, 016 MTFA MR, 017 RangeBreakout MT5) + 1 official freqtrade repo port (TrendRiderOfficial). **Result: 0/8 verified, 0/8 strict-pass on ETH/USDT × native TF.**

- 3-attempt rule exhausted on all 8

tasks.title: 15 Days
tasks.why: 15 Days is the single Minato revenue sprint. It combines market validation, Intelligence Engine infrastructure, lead collection, processing/enrichment, and the practical path toward the first paid offer. The goal is not just to build a system — it is to connect the system to real buyers and revenue.

subtasks.description: M2 creates the core storage and data architecture. It establishes the database, schemas, source attribution, confidence scoring, history tracking, and relationships required to support lead generation, audits, monitoring, and future intelligence products.

subtasks.title: Stage 4 — Genome Schema
subtasks.description: Defines what a candidate is. Three genome sections: DCA, TP, Safety. Calculation block representation, input representation, combination method, mutation metadata, lineage, validation rules, serialization. Example files.
subtasks.nextAction: Define genome.py with class CandidateGenome. Sections: dca_genome { grid_method, allocation_method, combo_method, params }, tp_genome { exit_method, params }, safety_genome { max_dca_layers, overlap_allowed, min_break_even_for_overlap }. Each calculation block has: type, inputs, params, output. Validators: param ranges, required combos. Serialization: JSON + msgpack. Output: 5 example genome files.

subtasks.title: Stage 5 — Locked Reward / Scoring Engine
subtasks.description: Deterministic scoring. LOCKED weights: 0.55 profit, 0.15 DD quality, 0.10 Sharpe, 0.10 PF, 0.10 trades/mo. Hard rejection rules. Drawdown penalty tiers (25-30% ×0.85, 30-35% ×0.50, >35% reject).
subtasks.nextAction: Build reward/ module. Components: normalizer.py (per-component min-max over population), profit_normalizer.py, dd_quality.py, sharpe.py, profit_factor.py, trades_per_month.py, scorer.py. Apply hard rules: net<=0 reject, DD>35% reject, TPM<5 reject, invalid equity reject. Apply DD penalty tiers. Output component breakdown per score for debugging.

subtasks.title: Stage 6 — Month-by-Month Fitness Engine
subtasks.description: Walk-forward monthly fitness. NOT a later filter — built into fitness score. Average monthly score, profitable month ratio, worst month, monthly DD stability, profit concentration (top 1 >50% penalty, top 3 >75% penalty).
subtasks.nextAction: Build fitness/ module. monthly_segmenter.py splits 5y into 60 monthly windows. monthly_scorer.py runs reward engine per month. consistency.py calculates: avg_monthly_score, profitable_month_ratio, worst_month_score, monthly_dd_std. concentration.py: top_1_share, top_3_share. Penalties (not rejection) for concentration. Combines full-period + monthly into final fitness. Output monthly_performance table per candidate.

subtasks.title: Stage 7 — DCA Completion Safety Engine
subtasks.description: Structural risk control. Before accepting a candidate, verify it can fund its full DCA sequence under worst historical adverse BTC move. Checks margin requirements, free buffer, multi-cycle overlap funding.
subtasks.nextAction: Build safety/ module. margin_model.py computes required margin per cycle. worst_adverse_replay.py uses data/metadata/worst_adverse_move.json. funding_check.py verifies cycle can complete. multi_cycle_check.py verifies all overlapping cycles funded under same stress. free_margin_buffer.py enforces min buffer. Output: safety_pass_fail.json with reason codes.

subtasks.title: Stage 8 — DCA Calculation Library
subtasks.description: Modular DCA calc library. Grid spacing methods, allocation methods, hybrid combiner. All blocks must be selectable + tunable + combinable by genome.
subtasks.nextAction: Build dca_calc/ module. Grid spacing: fixed_pct, atr_based, volatility_based, drawdown_from_high, ma_distance, rsi_oversold, z_score, trend_adjusted. Allocation: equal, linear_increasing, controlled_exp, dd_adjusted, volatility_adjusted. Hybrid combiner: weighted_average, conditional_switch. Cap/normaliser. Unit tests for each block.

subtasks.title: Stage 9 — Simple Fixed TP Baseline
subtasks.description: Simple TP from average entry. Used to test DCA candidates before TP evolution begins. Establishes baseline DCA+TP performance.
subtasks.nextAction: Build tp_engine/simple_fixed.py. Takes tp_pct param. Closes cycle when price >= avg_entry * (1 + tp_pct). Cycle close resets state machine. Run baseline: 1 fixed DCA + fixed TP. Print score. Confirm harness end-to-end works.

subtasks.title: Stage 10 — DCA Library Evolution (Gen 1+)
subtasks.description: First evolutionary loop. 500 candidates per generation. Mutate DCA genomes, freeze TP. Cull bottom 80%, reproduce top 20%. Fitness = full-period score + monthly consistency + safety pass.
subtasks.nextAction: Build evolution/ module. genome_generator.py creates 500 random DCA genomes. mutation.py (small param changes, block swap, method change). crossover.py (mix two parents). selection.py (top 20%). parallel_runner.py (multiprocess, SQLite results). Repeat until convergence or 20 gens. Output: dca_leaderboard.json, generation_history.json, best_genome.json.

subtasks.title: Stage 11 — TP / Exit Calculation Library
subtasks.description: Modular TP library. 12+ exit blocks. Fixed TP, ATR TP, vol-adjusted, DCA-depth adjusted, partial ladders, trailing TP, break-even, momentum decay, exhaustion, trend hold, failed-continuation, time-in-position, hybrid combiner.
subtasks.nextAction: Build tp_calc/ module. Each block: decision_func(state, params) -> action. State includes: avg_entry, current_price, unrealised_pnl, time_in_cycle, dca_depth, recent_volatility, trend_strength. Hybrid combiner blends outputs. Unit tests.

subtasks.title: Stage 12 — TP Library Evolution (Gen 1+)
subtasks.description: TP evolution using frozen top-DCA candidates. 500 TP candidates per gen. Cull/mutate/recombine TP genomes. DCA stays fixed.
subtasks.nextAction: Build tp_evolution/ — load top N DCA candidates from Stage 10. Generate 500 random TP genomes per DCA parent. Score = full + monthly + safety. Cull bottom 80%. Reproduce. Repeat 20 gens. Output tp_leaderboard.json, best_tp_per_dca.json.

subtasks.title: Stage 13 — DCA + TP Combination Testing
subtasks.description: Pair strong DCA systems with strong TP systems. Matrix run. Detect conflicts (e.g., tight TP + deep DCA). Rank combinations.
subtasks.nextAction: Build combination/ module. Load top K DCA from Stage 10 and top L TP from Stage 12. Run K*L matrix. Score with full + monthly + safety. Detect conflicts: time_in_position TP cancelling layered DCA, tight trailing vs slow allocation. Output combination_leaderboard.json, compatibility_report.json, conflict_examples.json.

subtasks.title: Stage 14 — Joint Evolution (DCA + TP organism)
subtasks.description: Full organism evolution. DCA + TP adapt together. Relationship-aware mutation. 500 candidates/gen. Stagnation detection. Multi-gen improvement tracking.
subtasks.nextAction: Build joint_evolution/ module. Full genome mutation (DCA + TP together). Relationship mutation: link DCA depth to TP activation threshold. Crossover across full genome. Stagnation detection: if best score flat for 5 gens, increase mutation rate, inject 20% fresh blood. Track gen-over-gen improvement. Final leaderboard. Joint evolution report.

subtasks.title: Stage 15 — Reporting / Review System
subtasks.description: Human-readable reports. Per-candidate breakdown, monthly tables, safety reports, drawdown reports, generation leaderboards, best genome export.
subtasks.nextAction: Build reports/ module. Generate per-candidate: score breakdown table, monthly perf table, safety pass/fail, drawdown curve, trade distribution, profit concentration. Generate per-generation: leaderboard, family trees, stagnation warnings. Export best genome as deployable JSON. Generate rejected-candidate reason report.

subtasks.title: Stage 16 — Stress Testing
subtasks.description: Multi-regime stress tests on top candidate. Spread/slippage sensitivity, commission sensitivity, worst adverse move replay, low-vol, high-vol, trend, range, crash, slow bleed, V-recovery.
subtasks.nextAction: Build stress/ module. Run winning candidate from Stage 14 across 10 regime replays. Inject 2x/3x spread, 1.5x/2x slippage, 1.5x commission. Report: regime_score per regime, breakdown points, failure modes. Output stress_report.json with regime-by-regime survival chart.

subtasks.title: Stage 17 — Paper Testing Preparation
subtasks.description: Plan for live paper testing. Mode design, data input, logging, daily/weekly review report. NOT live trading — paper only.
subtasks.nextAction: Design paper_trading/ module. Live candle feed (exchange API). Order simulation layer. Full execution log. Signal log. DCA layer log. TP decision log. Safety failure log. Daily report: PnL, cycle status, layer status, safety violations. Weekly summary. Requires Six's explicit go-ahead before live paper trading starts.

subtasks.title: Review Gates (12 total)
subtasks.description: Hard gates that block progression. No dangerous stage starts without Six's review and explicit accept.
subtasks.nextAction: Each gate produces a reviewable artefact. Gate 1: project skeleton accepted. Gate 2: data quality report accepted. Gate 3: DCA skeleton smoke test passed. Gate 4: reward engine produces deterministic scores. Gate 5: monthly fitness report makes sense. Gate 6: safety engine catches unsafe DCA designs. Gate 7: DCA library unit tests passed. Gate 8: TP library unit tests passed. Gate 9: combination leaderboard reviewed. Gate 10: joint evolution leaderboard reviewed. Gate 11: stress test report reviewed. Gate 12: paper test plan approved.
